title: England's most capped players
brief: Name the ten players with the most caps for England in full internationals, to the end of the 2026 World Cup.

notes.Kyle Walker: Kyle Walker is 11th with 96, just outside.
notes.Harry Kane: Harry Kane had 121 caps at the end of the 2026 World Cup; caps since then don't count here.

checks: Wikipedia's records page on 19 July 2026, England Football Online's most-appearances list (updated 18 July 2026) and Transfermarkt's match data (counted to 19 July 2026) all give the same ten with the same figures: Kane 121 at the cut-off (124 now). RSSSF (to November 2025) agrees for everyone else. Walker 96 and Stones 94 confirmed by EFO and Transfermarkt.
